title: Man Gets Caught Pretending to be a Cop at a Park
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On December 19, 2023, police responded to a report of a suspicious person in West Salem, WI. The individual approached a woman, posing as a La Crosse County Sheriff’s Reserve Deputy and claimed his affiliation with several other departments. Despite lacking law enforcement credentials and official markings, he claimed to be searching for a missing woman in the woods. The woman, feeling uneasy, contacted the non-emergency dispatch. 

Our featured content aims to depict law enforcement interactions, emphasizing education over public shaming or ridicule. In a world filled with misleading conversations about law enforcement, it's crucial to present these interactions within their contexts to inform and educate the public.
